parentEventId.description: For grouped events. The parent is an existing event at the same venue, not the event itself, and has no parent of its own (one level; ADAM CR-256). Declared as a key onto `catalogue.event`.

performanceCount.description: How many performances the event has. Counted by the server; never sent by a client.

lifecycleState.description: **Where the event is in its lifecycle** (4 October 2026, CHG-FXC-003; catalogue.event had nowhere to keep it). Written only by `setEventLifecycleState` and the event lifecycle job, which check the transition against `states/event.yaml` (ADAM CR-109); `createEvent` and `cloneEvent` create an event in `draft`. `isActive` stays the switch that hides an event from sale without changing its state.

scheduledLifecycleState.description: **A move waiting for its effectiveFrom** (ADAM CR-109, option 2; CHG-R10CAT-009): written by `setEventLifecycleState` when `effectiveFrom` is in the future, applied and cleared by the event lifecycle job in the workers host at `scheduledLifecycleAt`. Null when nothing waits.

scheduledLifecycleAt.description: When the waiting move is applied (the request's `effectiveFrom`; ADAM CR-109).

scheduledLifecycleReason.description: The reason given with the waiting move, carried on `event.lifecycleChanged` when it is applied (ADAM CR-109).

EventCapacityProfile.description: Event board 4.2. **Capacity is four numbers, not one.**

mode.description: **The same hall is seated on Friday and standing on Saturday**, so the mode is per performance.
